1) The adjudication leans on “neutral aromatic / non-CT” but does not squarely justify overruling the model’s own candidate distribution that strongly favors ICT/ESIPT/TICT and places neutral aromatic at 0.10 (structure_candidate_distribution; also consistent with high mechanism entropy 0.937). This needs an explicit “why posterior overrides prior” paragraph anchored to specific discriminators (e.g., lack of PT sites, near-zero torsion change, low redistribution).
2) The ICT discussion underweights the key counterevidence that the charge-redistribution proxy is low and distributed (E35, E36) and that dipole change is small (features_summary delta_perm_dipole_tot_debye ≈0.098; no evidence_id was assigned to this, so it should be promoted into the evidence registry next round). If ICT remains “secondary,” state what magnitude/shape of redistribution would have been expected and how far the target falls short.
3) The supporting chain has evidence-to-step mismatches: step A (“torsion_access”) cites E72 (emission shift) rather than torsion/relaxation evidence like E21/E31/E37; step B (“ct_family”) cites E73 (observation reliability) rather than redistribution evidence (E35/E36) or delta_gap comparison (E22). This weakens traceability.
4) The narrative conflates multiple “bucket systems” without reconciliation: delta_gap is “moderate” in atb_trends_self but “low” in atb_trend_profile, while E32 is labeled “bucket=low” though its numeric delta_gap_abs is ~0.388 and the redistribution profile calls delta_gap_bucket “mid” (E36). A short clarification of which profile is authoritative and why is needed.
5) The “overall_motion_proxy high” (E34) is used to imply non-torsional compaction, but the structural relaxation proxy is simultaneously “low” despite high volume change (E37). The writeup should explain this apparent paradox (e.g., proxy construction penalizes torsion/bond/angle more than volume; or volume change may not couple to nonradiative decay in the intended way).
6) Emission shift is correctly treated as high-reliability and small/flat (E72, E73), but “flat shift” alone is not decisive between locally excited vs some ICT cases; it should be framed as weak-to-moderate evidence unless paired with solvatochromism/lifetime/temperature dependence (currently only proposed as generic tests).
